def rects(g, col=8):
    # find maximal horizontal runs per row, then group identical consecutive ones
    runs={}  # row -> list of (c0,c1)
    for r in range(len(g)):
        rr=[]; c=0
        while c<len(g[0]):
            if g[r][c]==col:
                c0=c
                while c<len(g[0]) and g[r][c]==col: c+=1
                rr.append((c0,c-1))
            else: c+=1
        runs[r]=rr
    out=[]
    used=set()
    for r in range(len(g)):
        if (r,0) in used or not runs[r]: continue
        r2=r
        while r2+1<len(g) and runs[r2+1]==runs[r]: r2+=1
        for rr in runs[r]:
            out.append((r,rr[0],r2,rr[1]))
        for k in range(r,r2+1): used.add((k,0))
    return out

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); m=[[v==8 for v in r] for r in g]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):

    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    fl,frt=min(c[1] for c in cells8),max(c[1] for c in cells8)
    sR=(fb-ft+1)/keyH; sC=(frt-fl+1)/kw
    for (i,j,w,h) in bl:
